name: Shell_Load
description: looks up ShellMain / ShellWindowProc in the front-end DLL with GetProcAddress

name: Fatal_Message
description: message box with the game title; default text "not enough memory"

name: Opponents_Load
description: reads multicar.def and the NVCL*.vcf opponent vehicle files

name: Objectives_LoadText
description: the mission's objective text file (.npt) for the Notepad

name: Notepad_Init
description: the Notepad device context and font; loads cnote.wav

name: Objective_Reveal
description: un-hides an objective

name: Objective_Succeed
description: marks an objective succeeded

name: Objective_Fail
description: marks an objective failed

name: Font_AddResource
description: installs ee_____.ttf through a .fot font resource

name: Cd_FindByLabel
description: finds the CD drive by volume label (I76_CD)

name: Files_Init
description: start-up: the CD by label, the xyzzy probe, then i76.zix (fatal without it)

name: Zix_ReadRoots
description: reads a ZIX's root lines (disc label lines, DIR:, CD<n>:) up to the separator

name: Zix_Load
description: loads the file index: count, roots, "<root> <name>" lines into 48-byte records, sorted, duplicates merged

name: Zix_CompareName
description: qsort comparison of index records: case-insensitive name

name: Bwd2_Walk
description: walks a BWD2 chunk list against a descriptor table {tag, 0, handler, flags}: unknown, mandatory, count and repeat chunks

name: Bwd2_IsExit
description: true for an EXIT chunk

name: Vtfc_Load
description: VTFC handler: registers the paint's slots of parts V1, V3, V5, the bumpers, the chunk names

name: Vtf_RegisterRegion
description: binds a region's six side slots (FT BK RT LF TP UN) to "<prefix><side>.map"

name: Poly_FillFlat
description: a convex polygon in one colour, shaded once through the lum table from vertex 0's depth; ported (src/render/poly.c), diffed against the original

name: Poly_FillGouraud
description: a convex polygon in one colour, Gouraud-shaded through the lum table; rewrites the vertices' q as 16.16 shades; ported, diffed

name: DrawPoly
description: points, lines, polygons: clip[mode] (0x4d7488) then fill[mode] (0x4d6c88) with the x87 rounding up

name: DrawPoint
description: DrawPoly with one vertex

name: DrawLine
description: DrawPoly with two vertices

name: Poly_FillTexAffine
description: a convex polygon textured with u, v linear in screen space (mode 0x04); scales the vertices' u, v to 16.16 texels in place; ported, diffed

name: Poly_FillTexPersp
description: a convex polygon textured perspective-correct (mode 0x14): exact u, v every 16 pixels, linear between; ported, diffed
